quranTranslation.text: Warfare is ordained for you, though it is hateful unto you; but it may happen that ye hate a thing which is good for you, and it may happen that ye love a thing which is bad for you. Allah knoweth, ye know not.

explanation.bs: „Allah zna, vi pak ne znate“ – znanje koje je samo Allahovo.
explanation.en: “Allah knoweth, ye know not” — knowledge that is Allah's alone.

quranTranslation.text: And with Him are the keys of the Invisible. None but He knoweth them. And He knoweth what is in the land and the sea. Not a leaf falleth but He knoweth it, not a grain amid the darkness of the earth, naught of wet or dry but (it is noted) in a clear record.

explanation.bs: Ključeve gajba zna samo On – za Allahovo znanje stoji عَلِمَ, ne عَرَفَ.
explanation.en: The keys of the unseen none knows but He — Allah's knowledge is expressed with عَلِمَ, not عَرَفَ.

quranTranslation.text: So know (O Muhammad) that there is no Allah save Allah, and ask forgiveness for thy sin and for believing men and believing women. Allah knoweth (both) your place of turmoil and your place of rest.

explanation.bs: „Znaj, dakle, da nema boga osim Allaha“ – znanje kao čvrsto uvjerenje.
explanation.en: The command “So know … that there is no Allah save Allah” — knowledge as firm conviction.

quranTranslation.text: And Joseph's brethren came and presented themselves before him, and he knew them but they knew him not.

explanation.bs: Jusuf je prepoznao svoju braću, a oni njega nisu – عَرَفَ nasuprot مُنكِرُونَ, kako ar-Rāġib i kaže.
explanation.en: Joseph recognised his brothers while they did not know him — عَرَفَ set against مُنكِرُونَ, just as ar-Rāġib says.

quranTranslation.text: Those unto whom We gave the Scripture recognise (this revelation) as they recognise their sons. But lo! a party of them knowingly conceal the truth.

explanation.bs: Oni kojima smo dali Knjigu poznaju ga kao što poznaju sinove svoje (tefsir se razilazi: Poslanika, ili istinu o kibli) – prepoznavanje po poznatim znakovima.
explanation.en: Those given the Scripture recognise it as they recognise their sons (tafsir differs: the Prophet, or the truth of the qibla) — recognition by known signs.

quranTranslation.text: When they listen to that which hath been revealed unto the messengers, thou seest their eyes overflow with tears because of their recognition of the Truth. They say: Our Lord, we believe. Inscribe us as among the witnesses.

explanation.bs: Oči im liju suze zbog istine koju su prepoznali.
explanation.en: Their eyes overflow with tears for the truth they have recognised.

quranTranslation.text: Call unto the way of thy Lord with wisdom and fair exhortation, and reason with them in the better way. Lo! thy Lord is Best Aware of him who strayeth from His way, and He is Best Aware of those who go aright.

explanation.bs: „…i raspravljaj s njima na način koji je najljepši“ – naređena, lijepa rasprava.
explanation.en: “…and reason with them in the better way” — commanded, gracious argument.

quranTranslation.text: Allah hath heard the saying of her that disputeth with thee (Muhammad) concerning her husband, and complaineth unto Allah. And Allah heareth your colloquy. Lo! Allah is Hearer, Knower.

explanation.bs: „Allah je čuo riječ žene koja se s tobom raspravlja o svom mužu“ – rasprava žene koja traži pravdu.
explanation.en: “Allah hath heard the saying of her that disputeth with thee (Muhammad) concerning her husband” — a woman arguing for justice.

quranTranslation.text: Those who wrangle concerning the revelations of Allah without any warrant that hath come unto them, it is greatly hateful in the sight of Allah and in the sight of those who believe. Thus doth Allah print on every arrogant, disdainful heart.

explanation.bs: „…oni koji se raspravljaju o Allahovim ajetima bez ikakvog dokaza koji im je došao“ – pokudna rasprava.
explanation.en: “Those who wrangle concerning the revelations of Allah without any warrant that hath come unto them” — blameworthy argument.

quranTranslation.text: Bethink thee of him who had an argument with Abraham about his Lord, because Allah had given him the kingdom; how, when Abraham said: My Lord is He Who giveth life and causeth death, he answered: I give life and cause death. Abraham said: Lo! Allah causeth the sun to rise in the East, so do thou cause it to come up from the West. Thus was the disbeliever abashed. And Allah guideth not wrongdoing folk.

explanation.bs: „Zar nisi vidio onoga što se s Ibrahimom raspravljao o njegovom Gospodaru?“ – spor dokazima o Allahu.
explanation.en: “Bethink thee of him who had an argument with Abraham about his Lord” — a dispute of proofs about Allah.

quranTranslation.text: His people argued with him. He said: Dispute ye with me concerning Allah when He hath guided me? I fear not at all that which ye set up beside Him unless my Lord willeth aught. My Lord includeth all things in His knowledge. Will ye not then remember?

explanation.bs: „I narod njegov se s njim raspravljao. Rekao je: Zar se sa mnom o Allahu raspravljate…“ – Ibrahim pred svojim narodom.
explanation.en: “His people argued with him. He said: Dispute ye with me concerning Allah…” — Abraham before his people.

quranTranslation.text: Lo! ye are those who argue about that whereof ye have some knowledge: Why then argue ye concerning that whereof ye have no knowledge? Allah knoweth. Ye know not.

explanation.bs: „…pa zašto se raspravljate o onome o čemu nemate znanja?“ – raspravljanje bez znanja.
explanation.en: “Why then argue ye concerning that whereof ye have no knowledge?” — argument without knowledge.

quranTranslation.text: Then lo! on the Day of Resurrection, before your Lord ye will dispute.

explanation.bs: „Zatim ćete se, zaista, na Sudnjem danu pred svojim Gospodarom sporiti“ – spor pred Allahom.
explanation.en: “Then lo! on the Day of Resurrection, before your Lord ye will dispute” — a quarrel before Allah.

quranTranslation.text: These twain (the believers and the disbelievers) are two opponents who contend concerning their Lord. But as for those who disbelieve, garments of fire will be cut out for them; boiling fluid will be poured down on their heads,

explanation.bs: „Ovo su dvije suprotstavljene strane koje su se sporile o svom Gospodaru“ – dvije zavađene strane (tefsir: vjernici i nevjernici, ili dvoboj na Bedru).
explanation.en: “These twain are two opponents who contend concerning their Lord” — two opposing parties (tafsir: believers and disbelievers, or the duel at Badr).

quranTranslation.text: He saith: Contend not in My presence, when I had already proffered unto you the warning.

explanation.bs: „Ne sporite se preda Mnom“ – Allah prekida spor: upozorenje je već bilo dato.
explanation.en: “Contend not in My presence” — Allah closes the dispute: the warning had already been given.

quranTranslation.text: Their Prophet said unto them: Lo! Allah hath raised up Saul to be a king for you. They said: How can he have kingdom over us when we are more deserving of the kingdom than he is, since he hath not been given wealth enough? He said: Lo! Allah hath chosen him above you, and hath increased him abundantly in wisdom and stature. Allah bestoweth His Sovereignty on whom He will. Allah is All-Embracing, All-Knowing.

explanation.bs: „…i dao mu obilje u znanju i tjelesnom stasu (وَالْجِسْمِ)“ – stas kao vrlina vođe.
explanation.en: “…and hath increased him abundantly in wisdom and stature” — build as a leader's merit.

quranTranslation.text: And when thou seest them their figures please thee; and if they speak thou givest ear unto their speech. (They are) as though they were blocks of wood in striped cloaks. They deem every shout to be against them. They are the enemy, so beware of them. Allah confound them! How they are perverted!

explanation.bs: „A kad ih vidiš, dopadaju ti se njihova tijela (أَجْسَامُهُمْ)“ – stas bez sadržine.
explanation.en: “And when thou seest them their figures please thee” — build without substance.

quranTranslation.text: And the folk of Moses, after (he left them), chose a calf (for worship), (made) out of their ornaments, of saffron hue, which gave a lowing sound. Saw they not that it spake not unto them nor guided them to any way? They chose it, and became wrong-doers.

explanation.bs: „…tele, tijelo (جَسَدًا) iz kojeg se čulo mukanje“ – beživotni lik.
explanation.en: The people of Moses took a calf, a mere body (جَسَدًا) that lowed — a lifeless figure.

quranTranslation.text: We gave them not bodies that would not eat food, nor were they immortals.

explanation.bs: „I nismo ih učinili tijelima (جَسَدًا) koja ne jedu hranu“ – vjerovjesnici su bili ljudi.
explanation.en: “We gave them not bodies that would not eat food” — the prophets were human.

quranTranslation.text: But this day We save thee in thy body that thou mayst be a portent for those after thee. Lo! most of mankind are heedless of Our portents.

explanation.bs: „Pa danas ćemo spasiti tvoje tijelo (بِبَدَنِكَ), da budeš znak onima poslije tebe“ – mnogi mufesiri: mrtvo tijelo; neki: s oklopom.
explanation.en: “But this day We save thee in thy body that thou mayst be a portent for those after thee” — many mufassirun: the lifeless body; some: with the coat of mail.

quranTranslation.text: When He made the slumber fall upon you as a reassurance from him and sent down water from the sky upon you, that thereby He might purify you, and remove from you the fear of Satan, and make strong your hearts and firm (your) feet thereby.

explanation.bs: „I spušta vam s neba vodu da vas njome očisti“ – čišćenje tijela.
explanation.en: “And sent down water from the sky upon you, that thereby He might purify you” — cleansing of the body.

quranTranslation.text: And when the angels said: O Mary! Lo! Allah hath chosen thee and made thee pure, and hath preferred thee above (all) the women of creation.

explanation.bs: „O Merjema, Allah te je zaista odabrao i očistio“ – ar-Rāġib ovo ubraja u čišćenje duše.
explanation.en: “O Mary! Lo! Allah hath chosen thee and made thee pure” — ar-Rāġib counts this as purifying of the soul.

quranTranslation.text: Take alms of their wealth, wherewith thou mayst purify them and mayst make them grow, and pray for them. Lo! thy prayer is an assuagement for them. Allah is Hearer, Knower.

explanation.bs: „Uzmi od njihovih imetaka sadaku kojom ćeš ih očistiti (تُطَهِّرُهُمْ) i oplemeniti (وَتُزَكِّيهِمْ)“ – obje riječi zajedno.
explanation.en: “Take alms of their wealth, wherewith thou mayst purify them (تُطَهِّرُهُمْ) and mayst make them grow (وَتُزَكِّيهِمْ)” — both words together.

quranTranslation.text: He is indeed successful who causeth it to grow,

explanation.bs: „Uspio je onaj ko je oplemeni (dušu)“ – oplemenjivanje sebe djelom, pohvaljeno.
explanation.en: “He is indeed successful who causeth it to grow” — purifying oneself by deeds, praised.

gloss.en: to purify (cause to grow in good)

quranTranslation.text: Those who avoid enormities of sin and abominations, save the unwilled offences - (for them) lo! thy Lord is of vast mercy. He is Best Aware of you (from the time) when He created you from the earth, and when ye were hidden in the bellies of your mothers. Therefor ascribe not purity unto yourselves. He is Best Aware of him who wardeth off (evil).

explanation.bs: „Zato ne hvalite sami sebe (فَلَا تُزَكُّوا أَنفُسَكُمْ); On najbolje zna ko je bogobojazan“ – ar-Rāġib: zabranjeno je hvaliti sebe riječima.
explanation.en: “Therefor ascribe not purity unto yourselves (فَلَا تُزَكُّوا أَنفُسَكُمْ). He is Best Aware of him who wardeth off (evil)” — ar-Rāġib: praising oneself in words is forbidden.

gloss.en: to purify (cause to grow in good)

quranTranslation.text: He it is Who hath sent among the unlettered ones a messenger of their own, to recite unto them His revelations and to make them grow, and to teach them the Scripture and wisdom, though heretofore they were indeed in error manifest,

explanation.bs: Poslanik „koji im kazuje Njegove ajete i oplemenjuje ih (وَيُزَكِّيهِمْ)“ – Poslanik kao posrednik.
explanation.en: A messenger “to recite unto them His revelations and to make them grow (وَيُزَكِّيهِمْ)” — the Prophet as the means.

gloss.en: to purify (cause to grow in good)
